variations.name: Unitary 240V heat pump water heaters
variations.description: A heat pump mounted on a storage tank pulls heat from surrounding air into the water at 3-4x the efficiency of resistance or gas units, making it the default drop-in appliance for electrifying the roughly 15-20% of home energy that goes to hot water.

companies.name: Rheem
companies.what: Largest North American water heater maker; ProTerra hybrid HPWH line is the US volume leader and was refreshed for 2025-26.
companies.signal: First to market with a 120V plug-in HPWH (2022); next-gen ProTerra rollout 2025-26

companies.name: A. O. Smith
companies.what: North America water-heating leader (Voltex HPWH line) investing heavily in heat pump and demand-response product development.
companies.signal: NYSE: AOS; opened a $30M Product Development Center focused on heat pump tech and demand-response connectivity

companies.name: Bradford White
companies.what: Employee-owned US major whose AeroTherm series is the third pillar of the US HPWH market alongside Rheem and A.O. Smith.
companies.signal: Acquired Bock Water Heaters (Apr 2025) to broaden commercial/specialty lines

companies.name: GE Appliances (Haier)
companies.what: Ships both 240V and 120V plug-in HPWHs in the US, one of only three brands covering the full voltage range.
companies.signal: Haier-owned; among the three makers fielding next-gen retrofit-ready HPWHs

companies.name: Stiebel Eltron
companies.what: German family-owned manufacturer whose Accelera line was among the earliest HPWHs sold in North America.
companies.signal: Named key player in global HPWH market reports; decades of European HPWH volume

companies.name: Ariston Group
companies.what: Milan-listed global water-comfort major whose NUOS heat pump water heaters lead European residential volumes.
companies.signal: Listed (BIT: ARIS); HPWH ranges sold across Europe and Asia

companies.name: LG Electronics
companies.what: Global appliance major that entered the US residential HPWH market with inverter-driven models.
companies.signal: Listed among leading HPWH players; US inverter HPWH launch circa 2024

variations.name: 120V plug-in and low-amperage HPWHs for no-rewire retrofits
variations.description: Low-amperage heat pump water heaters plug into a standard 120V outlet (often sharing an existing circuit), eliminating the panel upgrades and rewiring that block gas-to-electric water heater swaps in older homes and multifamily buildings.

companies.name: Rheem
companies.what: First to market (2022) with ProTerra Plug-in 120V models in dedicated-circuit and shared-circuit versions, the latter using a HydroBoost thermostatic mixing valve to stretch capacity.
companies.signal: 120V ProTerra launched 2022; positioned explicitly as gas-unit replacement with zero electrical work

companies.name: A. O. Smith
companies.what: 120V plug-in HPWH adding a backup heating element and field-convertibility to 240V, addressing slow-recovery objections.
companies.signal: Second-generation 120V entrant with backup element and 240V conversion

companies.name: GE Appliances (Haier)
companies.what: GE Profile 120V plug-in HPWH aimed at one-for-one gas replacements; units evaluated in the Advanced Water Heating Initiative's multi-state 120V field study.
companies.signal: Participant in AWHI 120V field study validating real-world retrofit performance

variations.white_space: Only the big three incumbents ship 120V units: shared-circuit operation forces small compressors and slow recovery (physics), and UL/SKU economics favor scale manufacturers. Openings: variable-speed low-amperage designs with predictive controls (the gap Cala Systems targets), 120V units bundled with mixing valves and storage intelligence, and multifamily channel plays where panel capacity is the binding constraint.

variations.name: Split-system and CO2-refrigerant HPWHs (residential)
variations.description: Splitting the compressor outdoors from the indoor tank and using natural CO2 refrigerant (GWP of 1) delivers 130-175F water even below -15F with no indoor noise or space penalty; the approach is mature in Japan as 'Eco Cute' and scaling in the US and Australia.

companies.name: ECO2 Systems (SANCO2)
companies.what: US successor to Sanden's SANCO2 split CO2 HPWH; COP near 5, operation to -14F, 43/83/119-gallon tanks for cold-climate homes.
companies.signal: Carried the SANCO2 line forward after Sanden's exit; sold through efficiency distributors like Small Planet Supply

companies.name: Reclaim Energy
companies.what: Australia's leading CO2 split-system HPWH brand with a smart controller built for solar self-consumption.
companies.signal: AU$5,000-6,500 installed; Victorian rebate raised to $1,400 for locally made units from Jul 2025, favoring its product

companies.name: Panasonic
companies.what: One of the major Japanese Eco Cute CO2 HPWH manufacturers.
companies.signal: Japanese Eco Cute cumulative shipments passed 10 million units as of March 2025

companies.name: Daikin
companies.what: Eco Cute CO2 HPWH maker inside the world's largest HVAC company.
companies.signal: Part of the >10M-unit Japanese Eco Cute installed base

companies.name: Mitsubishi Electric
companies.what: Eco Cute manufacturer that has exported its CO2 heat pump expertise into Western commercial markets via QAHV.
companies.signal: Launched QAHV CO2 water-heating heat pump in the US

companies.name: Corona
companies.what: Japanese heating manufacturer that launched the world's first Eco Cute residential CO2 HPWH in 2001.
companies.signal: First mover of a category that has since shipped >10M units in Japan

variations.white_space: Outside Japan only a couple of niche importers (ECO2 Systems, Reclaim) serve split-CO2 demand; $5-7k unit costs and installer unfamiliarity are the barriers. Tightening low-GWP refrigerant rules (A2L transition) create an opening for cost-reduced CO2 splits and for Japanese incumbents to localize Western residential product.

variations.name: Central/commercial heat pump water heating plants (multifamily, hospitality, commercial)
variations.description: Large air-to-water heat pump plants — often CO2-based to reach 150F+ storage temperatures — centrally produce domestic hot water for apartment blocks, hotels and commercial kitchens, displacing the gas boilers that dominate multifamily water heating.

companies.name: Mitsubishi Electric
companies.what: QAHV 40kW CO2 monobloc supplies 90C water at ambient temperatures down to -25C; launched in the US for commercial DHW.
companies.signal: QAHV deployed in UK/NZ/US commercial projects; flagship of code-driven central HPWH retrofits

companies.name: Lync by Watts
companies.what: Packages Aegis air-to-water CO2 heat pumps into engineered commercial water-heating plants under NYSE-listed Watts Water.
companies.signal: Watts (NYSE: WTS) brand created specifically for commercial heat pump water heating

companies.name: Nyle Water Heating Systems
companies.what: Maine manufacturer of modular commercial HPWHs (C-Series) for multifamily, industrial and institutional loads.
companies.signal: Named key player in North America commercial HPWH market reports

companies.name: Colmac WaterHeat
companies.what: Decades-old Washington-state specialist in air- and water-source commercial heat pump water heaters.
companies.signal: Long-standing key vendor in the NA commercial HPWH segment

companies.name: Intellihot
companies.what: Commercial tankless water-heating challenger expanding from gas into electric/heat-pump products (Electron line).
companies.signal: Venture/growth-backed gas incumbent-challenger pivoting its commercial install base toward electric

companies.name: Lochinvar (A. O. Smith)
companies.what: Commercial boiler and water-heating brand under A.O. Smith adding commercial heat pump water heater lines.
companies.signal: Listed among leading commercial HPWH players in 2024-25 market analyses

variations.white_space: Demand is code-driven (Washington and California all-electric and HPWH-credit codes) but nearly every job is custom-engineered with long design cycles. Opening for standardized packaged central-HPWH skids, sizing/design software, and heat-as-a-service offers that de-risk multifamily gas-boiler conversions.

variations.name: Smart and grid-interactive water heaters, connected tanks and intelligent controls
variations.description: Connected tanks and retrofit controllers treat every water heater as a pre-installed thermal battery, shifting heating into cheap, clean hours and selling demand response and even frequency-response services to utilities.

companies.name: Cala Systems
companies.what: Variable-speed HPWH with NREL-derived predictive controls that plan heating around forecast hot-water use, solar output and grid prices.
companies.signal: $5.6M seed (Aug 2024, MassCEC/Clean Energy Venture Group); first deliveries H1 2025; 65-gal unit at $2,850

companies.name: Aquanta
companies.what: Retrofit smart controller that clamps onto existing electric/gas tanks to enable monitoring and utility demand response.
companies.signal: Won Hawaiian Electric's next-gen program: 27,000 controllers / ~11MW of DR plus fast frequency response, rollout Q3 2025-2027

companies.name: Mixergy
companies.what: UK stratified smart hot-water tanks that heat only the water needed and aggregate into a virtual power plant.
companies.signal: £12M Series C (Mar 2025) led by Barclays Climate Ventures; British Gas pays owners for flexible heating; pivoting to licensing model

companies.name: Shifted Energy
companies.what: Hawaii-born Grid Maestro platform retrofitting water heaters in multifamily and underserved housing into grid assets.
companies.signal: Built Hawaii's grid-interactive water heater fleet; acquired by Resource Innovations (Oct 2025)

companies.name: Packetized Energy
companies.what: UVM spinout whose Mello controller 'packetized' water-heater demand for moment-to-moment grid balancing.
companies.signal: Acquired by EnergyHub (Mar 2022) and folded into its Mercury DERMS

companies.name: Steffes
companies.what: Grid-enabled electric thermal storage water heating (GETS) deployed for decades with Midwestern co-ops and utilities.
companies.signal: Long-running utility programs (e.g., Great River Energy territory) using its grid-interactive storage water heaters

companies.name: Rheem
companies.what: EcoNet-connected, CTA-2045-ready water heaters that satisfy Washington and Oregon demand-response-port mandates.
companies.signal: CTA-2045 DR ports now standard on its connected units; utility water-heater programs scale on its fleet

companies.name: Heatworks
companies.what: Smart ohmic (electrode) tankless water heater (Model 3) and countertop dishwasher; a cautionary tale in venture-backed water heating hardware.
companies.signal: TIME Best Invention 2018; entered receivership July 2022 after sales shortfalls; ~100 patents auctioned

variations.name: Combined space + water heating heat pump systems with integrated thermal storage
variations.description: A single heat pump charges a smart thermal-storage tank that serves both space heating/cooling and domestic hot water, cutting equipment count and letting the home buy heat at off-peak prices like a battery.

companies.name: Harvest Thermal
companies.what: Harvest Pod controller pairs a CO2 (SANCO2) heat pump with a standard tank used as a thermal battery for whole-home heat and hot water.
companies.signal: ~$15M raised across rounds; $2M DOE grant (Sep 2024) and $1.65M CEC RAMP grant; qualifies for $11,500 TECH rebates in CA

companies.name: Villara Building Systems
companies.what: AquaThermAire single-compressor combi heat pump (air handler + ambient-pressure thermal tank) serving HVAC and DHW in production homes.
companies.signal: Installed across six California new-home communities; 2024 Sacramento Inno award; targeting $20-25k installed

companies.name: Sunamp
companies.what: Phase-change-material 'Thermino' heat batteries that store heat-pump or off-peak energy in a quarter the space of a hot water cylinder.
companies.signal: £9.25M UK LODES demonstration across 100 homes (2024-25); Midea pairing launched Mar 2025; expanding in US/Canada/Italy

companies.name: Daikin
companies.what: Altherma air-to-water combi heat pumps with integrated DHW tanks — the European volume benchmark this category competes against.
companies.signal: Millions of Altherma units across Europe; integrated-DHW models standard

variations.white_space: US homes lack hydronic distribution and contractors treat combis as exotic, so only a handful of players exist despite combi dominance in Europe and Japan. Opening for packaged, forced-air-compatible combi kits and controls that let one heat pump serve HVAC + DHW with thermal storage as the load-shifting asset.

variations.name: Drain-water heat recovery
variations.description: A copper heat exchanger wrapped around the shower drain passively preheats incoming cold water with heat that would go down the drain, recovering 30-50% of shower energy with no moving parts; at building scale, wastewater energy transfer does the same for whole districts.

companies.name: RenewABILITY Energy (Power-Pipe)
companies.what: Original falling-film DWHR leader with the widest size range; the code-compliance staple in Canadian and net-zero programs.
companies.signal: Specified in most major North American net-zero pilot projects; energy-code recognized

companies.name: EcoDrain
companies.what: Plate-style heat exchangers that keep 30-45% recovery even in horizontal drain runs where vertical falling-film units cannot install.
companies.signal: Niche Quebec manufacturer; differentiated horizontal-install patent position

companies.name: ThermoDrain
companies.what: Quebec DWHR maker competing on price in Canada's code-driven new-construction market.
companies.signal: One of three brands dominating Canadian DWHR code compliance

companies.name: SHARC Energy Systems
companies.what: Building- and district-scale wastewater energy transfer (SHARC, Piranha) that filters sewage and extracts heat for DHW and space conditioning.
companies.signal: Public company (CSE: SHRC); installs across North America/UK district and multifamily projects

companies.name: Recoup Energy Solutions
companies.what: UK leader in vertical shower wastewater heat recovery (WWHRS) specified through SAP in new-build housing.
companies.signal: WWHRS routinely specified in UK volume housebuilding for SAP compliance

companies.name: Joulia
companies.what: Swiss maker of heat-recovery shower channels integrated directly into shower trays for new bathrooms.
companies.signal: Integrated into Swiss/European new-build and renovation bathroom supply chains

variations.white_space: The tech is mature, passive and cheap, yet adoption is tiny: retrofits need drain-stack access and save only tens of dollars a year per home, so no venture-scale company has formed. The realistic openings are code mandates (UK SAP, Canadian energy codes), bundling into multifamily central hot-water packages, and building-scale sewage heat recovery where SHARC is nearly alone.

variations.name: Solar thermal and PV-diversion water heating
variations.description: Rooftop thermal collectors — or, increasingly, diverters that dump surplus rooftop-PV electricity into the tank's element — heat water with on-site solar; classic collectors are ceding ground to PV-diversion as PV-plus-heat-pump economics win.

companies.name: myenergi
companies.what: Maker of the eddi, the category-defining solar PV power diverter for hot water, alongside its zappi EV charger.
companies.signal: ~$76M raised; ~400 staff; #30 in 2024 FEBE Growth 100; eddi launched in France 2025

companies.name: Marlec
companies.what: Long-standing UK manufacturer of the Solar iBoost+ immersion diverter, the main eddi alternative in retrofit.
companies.signal: Decades-old UK manufacturer with established installer channel

companies.name: Fronius
companies.what: Austrian inverter maker whose Ohmpilot diverts surplus PV to resistive water heating within its inverter ecosystem.
companies.signal: Ohmpilot bundled across Fronius's large European inverter installed base

companies.name: SolarEdge
companies.what: Offers smart hot-water diversion controllers as an add-on to its globally deployed PV inverter platform.
companies.signal: Nasdaq: SEDG; hot-water diversion sold as ecosystem accessory at global scale

companies.name: Solahart (Rheem)
companies.what: Australian solar water heating pioneer (since 1953) that added PowerStore PV-diverter water heating as collectors decline.
companies.signal: Rheem-owned; straddles legacy thermosiphon collectors and new PV-diversion products

companies.name: Himin Solar
companies.what: World's largest solar water heater manufacturer, anchored in China's evacuated-tube market.
companies.signal: China holds ~64% of global solar water collector sales; global market contracted 14.2% in 2024

companies.name: SunEarth
companies.what: Veteran US flat-plate collector manufacturer serving the residual American solar-thermal niche.
companies.signal: US solar water heater market only ~$47M (2024) — a shrinking niche

companies.name: Naked Energy
companies.what: UK maker of Virtu hybrid photovoltaic-thermal (PVT) vacuum tubes targeting commercial hot water decarbonization.
companies.signal: Corporate backing including E.ON; commercial deployments in UK, US and Japan

variations.white_space: Global collector sales fell 14.2% in 2024 (REN21) as cheap PV plus heat pumps undercuts glycol plumbing; residential solar-thermal startups are effectively extinct in the West. The live opening is software-defined PV diversion, DC-coupled water heating, and PVT for space-constrained commercial loads — not new collector brands.

variations.name: Hot-water efficiency: low-flow fixtures, demand recirculation, leak/flow monitoring
variations.description: Low-flow fixtures, demand-controlled recirculation pumps and AI leak/flow monitors cut the hot water — and the energy embedded in it — wasted in homes and commercial buildings, with insurers increasingly subsidizing deployment to avoid water-damage claims.

companies.name: Moen (Fortune Brands)
companies.what: Flo smart water monitor and automatic shutoff, the highest-volume whole-home leak protection device, often insurer-discounted.
companies.signal: Flagship smart-water line of NYSE-listed Fortune Brands Innovations; documented insurance claim reductions

companies.name: Phyn
companies.what: Belkin/Uponor joint venture using high-frequency pressure-wave sensing and ML to identify fixture-level leaks.
companies.signal: Pilots found leak issues in >10% of homes; sold through plumbing-pro channel

companies.name: Flume
companies.what: Strap-on meter sensor with ML that detects usage down to 0.01 gallon without cutting pipe — the no-plumber leak monitor.
companies.signal: HSB/Munich Re partnership (Mar 2025) distributing Flume through insurance carriers

companies.name: WINT Water Intelligence
companies.what: AI water management and auto-shutoff for commercial buildings and construction sites, where leak losses are largest.
companies.signal: $35M Series C (Aug 2023, Insight Partners/Inven Capital); clients include Empire State Building, Microsoft, Suffolk Construction

companies.name: Ondo InsurTech (LeakBot)
companies.what: Clip-on LeakBot sensor distributed free by home insurers, with a plumber-dispatch service closing the loop on found leaks.
companies.signal: LSE-listed (ONDO); insurer-funded rollouts in UK, US and Scandinavia

companies.name: Niagara Conservation
companies.what: High-efficiency 0.8 gpf toilets and low-flow showerheads/aerators that anchor utility and multifamily conservation programs.
companies.signal: Decades-long supplier to US utility direct-install efficiency programs

companies.name: Nebia
companies.what: Atomizing showerheads creating 10x water surface area to cut shower water ~50% without comfort loss.
companies.signal: Acquired by Brondell (Jan 2023); nozzle tech on track to save ~1B gallons in 2024

companies.name: ACT D'MAND Kontrols
companies.what: Demand-controlled hot-water recirculation pumps that deliver hot water fast without 24/7 recirc losses; earns California Title 24 compliance credits.
companies.signal: Long-standing niche standard for demand recirculation in US green building codes

variations.name: Induction and battery-integrated cooking (residential and commercial kitchen)
variations.description: Magnetic induction puts heat directly into the cookware — roughly 3x more efficient than gas with zero combustion pollution indoors — and battery-integrated stoves plug into a standard 120V outlet, dodging panel upgrades while doubling as grid-interactive home storage.

companies.name: Impulse Labs
companies.what: Battery-integrated induction cooktop with a 3kWh cell pack delivering 10kW peak per burner (boils water in ~40 seconds) on a standard circuit.
companies.signal: $25M raised (Lux-led Series A); cooktop shipping since Aug 2025

companies.name: Copper (Channing St. Copper Co.)
companies.what: 120V plug-in battery induction range ('Charlie') aimed at no-rewire apartment electrification, including public housing.
companies.signal: ~$35M raised (PitchBook); NYCHA deployments; patent-infringement suit against Impulse (2025) over battery-stove IP

companies.name: GE Appliances (Haier)
companies.what: Volume induction ranges and cooktops across GE Profile/Café lines for the US mass market.
companies.signal: Among top US appliance brands pushing induction mainstream

companies.name: BSH (Bosch/Siemens)
companies.what: European induction leader with broad premium induction lines sold in the US.
companies.signal: Induction is majority of its European cooktop sales

companies.name: Samsung
companies.what: Global top-2 appliance maker scaling smart induction ranges in North America.
companies.signal: Global appliance scale; induction range share growing in US

companies.name: CookTek (Middleby)
companies.what: Commercial countertop and delivery induction systems under foodservice-equipment giant Middleby.
companies.signal: Middleby (Nasdaq: MIDD) commercial-kitchen electrification portfolio brand

companies.name: Vollrath
companies.what: Mirage commercial induction hobs widely used in catering and foodservice.
companies.signal: Major US foodservice equipment incumbent with established induction line

companies.name: Garland (Ali Group)
companies.what: Heavy-duty commercial induction ranges and griddles for institutional kitchens replacing gas batteries de cuisine.
companies.signal: Flagship commercial induction brand within Ali Group/Welbilt

variations.white_space: Battery-integrated cooking has exactly two venture-backed players, now locked in patent litigation — evidence the niche is real but fragile. UL certification cost, appliance retail margins and incumbent brand power deter entrants; the opening is licensing battery-stove IP to incumbent OEMs and 120V multifamily retrofit channels rather than new D2C hardware brands.

variations.name: Heat pump clothes dryers, combo washer-dryers and commercial laundry
variations.description: Heat pump dryers and ventless washer-dryer combos recycle hot air in a closed loop, using 40-60% less energy than resistance dryers, running on 120V and needing no exhaust vent — removing the two biggest barriers to electrifying laundry in existing buildings.

companies.name: GE Appliances (Haier)
companies.what: UltraFast ventless heat pump combo washer/dryer — the breakout US all-in-one, 120V plug-in with ~50% drying-energy savings.
companies.signal: One of GE Appliances' most successful launches; stocked at Home Depot, Best Buy, Costco

companies.name: Whirlpool
companies.what: Launched its own ventless heat pump 2-in-1 combo (2024) to defend the US laundry market it leads.
companies.signal: US laundry share leader following GE into heat pump combos

companies.name: LG Electronics
companies.what: Global heat-pump laundry leader with WashCombo all-in-ones and standalone heat pump dryers.
companies.signal: Heat pump dryer volume leader globally; WashCombo a top US seller

companies.name: Samsung
companies.what: Bespoke AI Laundry Combo all-in-one heat pump washer/dryer competing head-to-head with LG/GE.
companies.signal: Global top-2 appliance maker with full HP laundry lineup

companies.name: Miele
companies.what: Heat-pump dryer pioneer; premium European incumbent whose tech made HP drying the EU default.
companies.signal: HP dryers are the majority of European dryer sales — category it helped create

companies.name: Beko (Arçelik)
companies.what: European volume leader in affordable, highly efficient heat pump dryers.
companies.signal: Among Europe's largest appliance groups; repeatedly tops EU dryer efficiency rankings

companies.name: Electrolux Professional
companies.what: Commercial heat-pump dryers for laundromats and on-premise laundries — closed-loop, vent-free, enabling gas dryer replacement.
companies.signal: Listed commercial-laundry major (EPRO-B) with shipping HP dryer lines

variations.white_space: No startups here — appliance manufacturing scale and thin retail margins lock the category to incumbents. The genuine white space is commercial laundry electrification (laundromats and hotels remain overwhelmingly gas-dryer) where heat-pump retrofit economics, panel constraints and financing are unsolved as a package.

variations.name: Heat pump pool and spa heaters
variations.description: Air-source heat pumps heat swimming pools at COPs of 5+ for a fraction of the running cost and carbon of the natural-gas heaters that still dominate pool heating, making pools one of the easiest big gas loads to electrify.

companies.name: Pentair
companies.what: UltraTemp and hybrid pool heat pumps from one of the two dominant US pool-equipment platforms.
companies.signal: NYSE: PNR; key vendor in $1.5B (2025) global pool heat pump market growing ~7% CAGR

companies.name: Hayward
companies.what: HeatPro pool heat pump line from the other dominant US pool-equipment maker.
companies.signal: NYSE: HAYW; named key vendor in 2025-2030 pool heat pump market report

companies.name: Raypak (Rheem)
companies.what: Leading pool-heating brand spanning gas and heat pumps — a direct gauge of the gas-to-heat-pump shift.
companies.signal: Rheem-owned; profiled among top pool heat pump vendors 2025-2030

companies.name: AquaCal (Team Horner)
companies.what: Dedicated US pool heat pump specialist, among the largest pure-play makers.
companies.signal: Profiled as key vendor in 2025-2030 pool heat pump market research

companies.name: Fluidra
companies.what: Spanish-listed global pool major (AstralPool, Zodiac) shipping inverter pool heat pumps worldwide.
companies.signal: BME-listed global pool equipment leader; key vendor in pool HP market reports

companies.name: Madimack
companies.what: Australian inverter pool heat pump scaleup expanding into commercial pools and broader hot-water electrification.
companies.signal: Fast-growing AU brand riding state gas-replacement rebate schemes

companies.name: Fairland
companies.what: Chinese full-inverter pool heat pump manufacturer supplying much of the global OEM/white-label volume.
companies.signal: Named key vendor (with PHNIX) in 2025-2030 pool heat pump market report
